Uśīnara
------------------------------------------
Uśīnara was a king of the चन्द्र-vaṁśa (lunar dynasty). He was ruling over the country called भोज. His wife was Mādhavī (daughter of the king ययाति). शिबि, the famous king who was prepared to sacrifice his life to save that of a dove, was his son.
Uśīnara was also the name of a country mentioned in the Mahābhārata (Karṇaparva 5) conquered by अर्जुन.
